slides.title: 5 website myths that cost you clients.
“Instagram is enough.”
slides.right: You rent Instagram. You own your website — and Google can find it.

slides.title: “It's too expensive.”
slides.left: Only big companies can afford one.
slides.right: Start with what you need today, add features as you grow.

slides.title: “Once it's live, it's done.”
slides.left: Build it once and forget it.
slides.right: Updates, security and fresh content keep it working for you.

slides.title: “I'm too small for a website.”
slides.right: Small businesses gain the most: they look as serious as the big ones.

slides.title: “I'll build it in a weekend.”
slides.left: Anyone can drag and drop a page.
slides.right: A page is easy. A page that brings clients takes strategy.

slides.title: Which myth did you believe?
slides.body: Tell us in the comments — then let's build the real thing.
